text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: W-why are you staring at me like that? You were just dozing off a moment ago, and suddenly you have this serious expression.
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんでこっちをじろじろ見てやがるんです？
さっきまでうとうとしてると思ったら、
急に真剣な顔になったですけど。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm fine! This Inori-chan is definitely the real deal! She won't suddenly say something poetic!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
大丈夫！
このイノリちゃんは間違いなく本物っぽい！
急にポエミーなこと言わなさそう！

text_block_list.name: Kasumi
text_block_list.text: Um, I don't really understand, but if Hatsune-san is okay with it, it's fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっと、
よく意味が分からないけれど、
ハツネさんが納得してるなら構わないよ。

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: And from here on, absolutely no napping, okay? It's already completely dark, and it wouldn't be strange if meteors came flying at any moment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あと、
ここから先は居眠り厳禁で頼むですよ。
もう完全に陽も沈んでるし、
いつ隕石が
飛んできてもおかしくねーですからね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: It's okay! After sleeping so soundly, I'm sure I can stay wide awake until the first sunrise!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫！
これだけぐっすり眠ったら、
初日の出まで
バッチリ起きてられると思うよ！

text_block_list.name: Kasumi
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit. Assistant-kun, are you prepared too? It's a one-shot deal... let's make it count!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その意気だ。
助手くんも
覚悟はいいね？
一発勝負だ……
確実に決めよう！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: For real this time, this is the last... snooooooze...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
正真正銘、
これが最後の……
スヤァァァァァ～！！
